app.name: Foto Booth Studio
app.tagline: Capture, templates, print, kiosk — runs without internet.

status.title: System status
status.subtitle: This app is built offline-first. This panel shows its resources.
status.modeOffline: Fully offline — capture, templates, print keep working
status.contentCacheNote: {{kinds}} content categories stored on this device.

capture.title: Photo session
capture.settingsLocked: Settings are locked while a session is running.
capture.noSignalBody: No signal from the camera. Check the HDMI cable or the camera battery.
capture.noSignalBodyWebcam: The camera stopped sending frames. Unplug and replug it, or pick another camera.
capture.stalledBody: The camera failed {{count}} times in a row. The session stopped — photos already taken are safe.
capture.demoMode: Demo mode: this browser has no camera, so a fake camera is being used.
capture.previewIdle: Pick a camera first, then hit “Prepare session”.
capture.storageMemory: Temporary storage: photos will not survive a page reload.
capture.errorInsecure: The camera needs a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).
capture.errorNotAllowed: Camera access denied. Allow it in your browser settings.
capture.errorMissing: No camera found. Make sure the device is connected.
capture.errorBusy: The camera is in use by another app.
capture.errorOverconstrained: The requested resolution is not supported by this camera.
capture.errorUnsupported: This browser does not support camera access.
capture.errorUnknown: Something went wrong while accessing the camera.
capture.noGallery: No active gallery yet — photos have no destination. Pick one on the “Gallery & upload” tab.
capture.filterHint: Applies to the next photos. The raw shot is kept safe if a filter fails.

install.hint: Install it on your device so it opens like a regular app, without a browser.

template.title: Template editor
template.subtitle: Lay out the print strip: drag, resize, rotate. Exports use full print resolution.
template.name: Template name
template.storageMemory: Temporary storage: templates will not survive a page reload.
template.previewEmpty: No photos from any session yet. Take photos first in the "Capture" tab.
template.previewLoaded: Using {{count}} photos from the last session.
template.noSelection: Pick an element on the canvas to edit its properties.
template.printBleedHint: Add 0.05 in on every side + cut marks (when the preset supports it).
template.vignetteHint: Darken the background edges so the eye goes to the middle
template.frameShadowHint: Add a shadow to the selected frame
template.printError: Could not prepare the print sheet: {{message}}

kiosk.title: Kiosk mode
kiosk.subtitle: Kiosk runs unattended: fullscreen, auto reset when the guest walks away, and a PIN to exit.
kiosk.fullscreenBlocked: The browser refused automatic fullscreen. Press "Enter kiosk mode" again, or press F11.
kiosk.wakeLockDenied: Refused by the browser (tab hidden / low battery)
kiosk.insecureWarning: The camera needs a secure connection. Open the kiosk over HTTPS or localhost — not a LAN IP address.
kiosk.pinMissing: No PIN is set while exit requires one. Anyone can leave kiosk mode right now.
kiosk.blockGestures: Block browser gestures (zoom, long-press menu, swipe-back)
kiosk.buttonsNote: Wired up here; the full UI arrives in Phase 9.
kiosk.pinConfigured: A PIN is set. It cannot be read back — only replaced.
kiosk.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
kiosk.attractBody: Touch the screen to start. Follow the countdown, then strike a pose.
kiosk.warningBody: Still there? The screen goes back to the start in {{seconds}} seconds.

gallery.title: Guest gallery
gallery.loginNote: Sign in with your registered email. A one-time code is sent to it.
gallery.qrHint: Guests scan this to open the album. Keep it up until the event ends.
gallery.qrFailed: Could not build the QR. The URL still works if typed in.
gallery.listEmpty: No galleries yet. Create one below.
gallery.createNote: A gallery is created per event and lasts 30 days. A new one becomes the active gallery right away.

upload.title: Upload queue
upload.needLogin: Sign in on the Gallery tab so photos can be uploaded.
upload.needGallery: Pick an active gallery on the Gallery tab so photos have a destination.
upload.syncFallback: Background sync unavailable ({{reason}}) — the app syncs on its own while the tab is open.
upload.syncUnsupported: this browser does not support it

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.hint: Turn off with ?debug=0 in the page address.

archive.title: Photo archive folder
archive.note: A local copy of every photo is written here, split per album. Gallery upload never depends on this archive — if archiving fails, the photo is still sent.
archive.unavailable: This browser has no local archive. Photos are still uploaded to the gallery.

booking.title: Booking & reservations
booking.signedOut: Sign in as operator in the Gallery & upload tab first. The session is shared, so one sign-in covers every tab.
booking.footerNote: Payments still run without a gateway. The operator records the deposit manually; QRIS/Midtrans/Xendit wiring lands in a separate phase.

report.title: Occupancy summary
report.empty: No data for this period yet.

pending.title: Needs review
pending.note: Requests not yet decided. Approve to lock the slot, or reject with a reason.

action.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? The slot is released.

packages.title: Packages & pricing
packages.empty: No packages yet. Create one below.
packages.name: Package name
packages.depositTooBig: Deposit cannot exceed the package price.

settings.title: Booking settings
settings.note: Buffer between sessions, minimum notice, and how far ahead guests may book.
settings.providerNote: Only manual mode is available. Gateway options appear in the payments phase.
settings.requireDeposit: Require a deposit before locking the slot
